definitions.gloss: rejection (of an application); not being hired; not being adopted
definitions.explanation: The result of not being selected in a job application, proposal, or submission. The opposite of being accepted or hired.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{不採用|ふさいよう}となりました。
examples.english: Unfortunately, your application was not accepted.

examples.japanese: {三社|さんしゃ}⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不採用|ふさいよう}だった。
examples.english: I was rejected by three companies in a row.

examples.japanese: {不採用|ふさいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}って→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}んだ→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I was discouraged when I received the rejection notice, but I changed my mindset.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly encountered in job hunting (⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧). Rejection notifications are sometimes called {不採用|ふさいよう}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧ or, colloquially, お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ ("prayer email"), because they typically include the phrase 「ご⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧」.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不採用|ふさいよう}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧ (rejection notice)
- {不採用|ふさいよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be rejected)
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}{選考|せんこう}→書類選考：21724_shoruisenkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不採用|ふさいよう} (rejected at the document screening stage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧: hiring, adoption (the opposite)
- ⟦{不合格|ふごうかく}→不合格：05139_fugoukaku⟧: failure (on an exam; different context)
